title: Pinterest Developers
snippet:
# Your AI just got a new
superpower
Pinterest MCP Server brings the power of Pinterest data directly into the AI assistants, copilots, and agentic workflows you already use. Turn natural-language questions into fast, actionable insights, uncover performance opportunities in moments, and build what's next with more momentum than ever. More Pinterest. More possibilities.

Meet the Pinterest MCP
## The common language of AI and APIs
Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an open standard that enables AI assistants to connect directly with external services. The Pinterest MCP Server brings Pinterest data into the AI tools you already use, giving agents native access to rich inspiration and creative signals — without custom code or fragile integrations. It helps teams move from idea to on-brand creative direction with Pinterest intelligence available right where they work.
Built for Pinterest workflows
Bring Pinterest Ads capabilities into the AI tools your team already uses. Query, analyze, and act through a consistent interface powered by the existing Pinterest API.
Open-standard integration
Built on MCP, with compatibility across tools such as Claude, Cursor, and VS Code.
Secure, scoped access
OAuth 2.0 authorization and granular permissions keep credentials protected and access appropriately controlled.
Less integration work
Skip custom API wrappers. The MCP server manages authentication, rate limits, and response formatting, so teams can move faster.
How it works
## Bring Pinterest intelligence into your AI workflow
Set up the Pinterest MCP Server once in your preferred AI environment. From there, you can search Pins, explore and manage Boards, uncover emerging trends, and access audience insights — all through natural-language prompts without leaving your chat or editor.
Find the performance stories hidden in your data.
Turn insights into action — create, update, and optimize with confidence.
Catch the next big idea before it takes off, using trends.
Turn audience and keyword signals into your next smart move.
```
{
"pinterest-mcp": {
"type": "http",
"url": "https://api.pinterest.com/mcp",
"headers": {
"Authorization": "Bearer <token>"
}
}
}
```

title: Pinterest keyword data in ChatGPT and Claude (MCP) · PinPinterest
snippet:
## 1. Get your API key
Create an account, then open **Settings → API** in the dashboard and press Create key. The same key works for the [REST API](/developers) and here, and both draw on one monthly allowance.
Server URL: `https://api.pinpinterest.com/mcp`
## 2. Add it to your app
### Claude Code
Run this once in your terminal, then ask Claude Code a Pinterest question.
```
claude mcp add --transport http pinpinterest https://api.pinpinterest.com/mcp \
--header "Authorization: Bearer pp_live_YOUR_KEY_HERE"
```
### Claude.ai & Claude Desktop
Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector.
Name it PinPinterest and paste this URL (with your key in place of the placeholder). Leave the OAuth fields empty.
```
https://api.pinpinterest.com/mcp?key=pp_live_YOUR_KEY_HERE
```
### ChatGPT (developer mode)
Settings → Apps & Connectors → Advanced settings → turn on Developer mode.
Create a connector, paste this URL (with your key), and choose "No authentication" — the key in the URL is the authentication.
```
https://api.pinpinterest.com/mcp?key=pp_live_YOUR_KEY_HERE
```
### Cursor
Add this to the file, then reload Cursor.
File: `~/.cursor/mcp.json`
```
{
"mcpServers": {
"pinpinterest": {
"url": "https://api.pinpinterest.com/mcp",
"headers": {
"Authorization": "Bearer pp_live_YOUR_KEY_HERE"
}
}
}
}
```
### VS Code (Copilot agent mode)
Add this to the file in your workspace, then start the server from the file.
File: `.vscode/mcp.json`
```
{
"servers": {
"pinpinterest": {
"type": "http",
"url": "https://api.pinpinterest.com/mcp",
"headers": {
"Authorization": "Bearer pp_live_YOUR_KEY_HERE"
}
}
}
}
```
### n8n
Add an MCP Client Tool node to your AI Agent and fill in these three fields.
```
Endpoint: https://api.pinpinterest.com/mcp
Server Transport: HTTP Streamable
Authentication: Bearer Auth → pp_live_YOUR_KEY_HERE
```
Replace `pp_live_YOUR_KEY_HERE` with your key. Keep a URL with your key in it private — anyone holding it can spend your lookups. You can revoke a key and make a new one at any time.

title: Introducing the Pinterest MCP Server
snippet:
# [Introducing the Pinterest MCP Server](https://community.pinterest.biz/t/introducing-the-pinterest-mcp-server/51358)
Pinterest is bringing its data and Ads capabilities directly into the AI tools teams already use. Built on the open Model Context Protocol (MCP), the Pinterest MCP Server lets AI assistants, copilots, and agentic workflows securely access Pinterest intelligence through natural-language prompts.
Want to learn more? Read all about it here: [Pinterest Developers](https://developers.pinterest.com/about-pinterest-mcp/)

title: Smarter decisions, faster results: Pinterest AI
snippet:
That's exactly what two new AI tools available from Pinterest are designed to do. At Cannes Lions 2026, Pinterest introduced connected updates that take a more practical approach to AI: Business Assistant and a new Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for partners. Together, they’re AI that understands your business, works with your existing tools and helps you make smarter decisions faster.

Pinterest’s open-source MCP server changes that. For the first time, approved partners can connect their own LLM agents and copilots directly to Pinterest data and workflows through a single, official integration layer.
Instead of rebuilding integrations from scratch, partners can use this layer for their AI assistants rather than developing and maintaining custom wrappers for each one. That makes it easier for you to plan, analyze and answer campaign questions inside the partner tools you already rely on.
Pinterest’s MCP server is starting with a small group of alpha partners on June 1st. Some partners include PMG, Pacvue, Dentsu, Innovid by Mediaocean and Omnicom’s Jump450.

- If you work directly in Ads Manager: Start using Business Assistant as it becomes available in your account. Use it to diagnose performance, get optimization ideas and explore trends for your next campaign.
- If you work with agencies or campaign management platforms: Ask your partners about their integration plans with the Pinterest MCP server and how they'll bring Pinterest data into their own copilots and cross-channel workflows.
- If you're building your own AI assistants or tools: Connect with your Pinterest team to understand the MCP roadmap and explore options to participate as an ecosystem partner.

title: pinterest-mcp-server/README.md at main · N-Graves/pinterest-mcp-server
snippet:
# pinterest-mcp-server
A [Model Context Protocol](https://modelcontextprotocol.io) server for the **Pinterest API v5**.
**263 of Pinterest's 266 published operations** are reachable. The three that are not are the OAuth token endpoints, excluded for a security reason rather than an access one. A test compares the catalogue against Pinterest's own OpenAPI spec, so when Pinterest ships an endpoint the build goes red.
It keeps itself authorised (Pinterest tokens expire after 30 days; this refreshes them), and it can pin local images, carousels and videos from one folder you choose.
MIT licensed.
## Install
```
npm install -g @nasdigitaluk/pinterest-mcp
```
## Authorise once
Create an app at [developers.pinterest.com/apps](https://developers.pinterest.com/apps) and add `http://localhost:3034/oauth/redirect` as a redirect URI. Then:
```
PINTEREST_APP_ID=your-app-id PINTEREST_APP_SECRET=your-app-secret pinterest-mcp-auth
```
Open the link it prints, sign in as the account the server should act as, and approve. It writes everything the server needs to `~/.pinterest-mcp-credentials` (mode `0600`) — the tokens, their expiry dates, and the app id and secret used to refresh them — and **prints no tokens**. It starts listening before it prints the link, so an occupied port fails at once instead of wasting the single-use code.
```
{
"mcpServers": {
"pinterest": {
"command": "pinterest-mcp",
"env": {
"PINTEREST_CREDENTIALS_FILE": "/home/you/.pinterest-mcp-credentials",
"PINTEREST_UPLOAD_DIR": "/home/you/pinterest-uploads"
}
}
}
}
```
`pinterest-mcp-auth --help` lists the options: `--port`, `--scopes`, `--add-scopes`. The default scopes cover reading and publishing organic content, including secret boards. They deliberately **leave out `ads:write`**: an active campaign spends money the moment it exists. Add `--add-scopes ads:read,catalogs:read` if you want ad reporting and catalogues.
### How long the tokens last
| | Lifetime | What happens |
|---|---|---|
| Access token | 30 days | Refreshed automatically five minutes before it expires. |
| Refresh token | 60 days, **renewed on every refresh** | So it never expires while the server is in use. Leave the server unused for more than 60 days and you need to run `pinterest-mcp-auth` again. |
Pinterest's refresh tokens rotate: each refresh returns a new one. Two MCP clients running at once is normal, and if both refreshed with the same stored token, one could save a token that has already been replaced — breaking the chain un
